name: hy-guard
description: Routes company MCP tools through a security gateway. Every request is signed with a device-bound key (DPoP); policy decides which tools the model can see.

platform_url.title: Platform URL
platform_url.description: Base URL of the security platform. Endpoints are discovered from <url>/.well-known/hy-platform.

key_provider.title: Device key storage
key_provider.description: auto = Secure Enclave on macOS, software key elsewhere.

ui_cards.title: Tool-call cards
ui_cards.description: Cards in the conversation for hy-guard tool calls: approvals = only calls that needed approval or were blocked; all = every call; off = none.

ui_status_line.title: Status line
ui_status_line.description: Show sign-in, device code and device posture in Claude Code's status line.

ui_band.title: Approval band
ui_band.description: Also show a band above the prompt while an approval is pending.
